label: intel
tips: Press Esc to abort the current operation, operator
With an empty prompt, press Esc twice to open the rewind menu
Press Shift+Tab to cycle permission modes, including plan mode
Run /clear between unrelated tasks to wipe the context and start clean
Run /compact to shrink a long session before the context window fills
Type ! then a command to run it in your shell and keep the output in the session
Press Ctrl+J to add a newline without sending the prompt
Run /status to see which settings files were loaded for this session
Run claude doctor in your shell when a setting seems to be ignored
Run /model to switch models mid-session, /effort to change reasoning effort
Run /usage to check your usage meter before a long run
Run /theme to switch colors, or press Ctrl+E on a custom theme to edit it
Put standing rules in CLAUDE.md so you never repeat yourself
Type @ in a prompt to point Claude at an exact file
Run /config to change settings without editing JSON by hand
